Title: Procurer recruiting another with The Shard

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Below question came up in the discord;

While having the edge and The Shard, London in play, can one have a Procurer that is in play recruit another Procurer with the help of The Shard by reducing the blood cost of it to 0?

Procurer,

Cardtype: Ally
Cost: 2 blood
Ghoul with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Procurer may move 1 blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you control as a +2 stealth action.

The Shard, London

Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique location.
If you have the Edge, you can lock this card to reduce the cost of a card you play by 2 pool or blood. Vampires can steal this location as a  action; Ventrue get +1 stealth during that action.

Messages.Author: Rathpex
Messages.Body:
I was on the fence about this but after having a read of the rulebook, my stance would be as follows:

Blood Cost (from the rulebook):
A number in a red drop represents blood cost (the amount of blood the vampire must burn). Only a vampire with enough blood on them can play a card with a blood cost.

The Shard:
If you have the Edge, you can lock this card to reduce the cost of a card you play by 2 pool or blood.

Applying the rulebook to the card:
The Shard ability is used after the card is played. The Shard must target a card after it has already been played. However the Procurer is unable to play the recruitment action in the first instance as Only a vampire with enough blood on them can play a card with a blood cost..

A non vampire is unable to recruit an ally with a blood cost by using the shard. Similar to how treaty of Laibach does not work on a Tremere.

To work, the shard would have to target a card in hand and reduce its cost BEFORE its played.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Rathpex wrote:
> Applying the rulebook to the card:
> The Shard ability is used after the card is played. The Shard must target a card after it has already been played. However the Procurer is unable to play the recruitment action in the first instance as Only a vampire with enough blood on them can play a card with a blood cost..
>
No, you can use the Shard to reduce the cost of a card you couldn't play otherwise.

> Rathpex wrote:
> A non vampire is unable to recruit an ally with a blood cost by using the shard.
>
A card that costs 0 blood doesn't cost blood at all. Thus, it can be played an ally.

Procurer costs 2 blood and you cannot reduce its cost before you play it, and, again from the rulebook:
Only a vampire with enough blood on them can play a card with a blood cost.

You cannot attempt something you can't do in hope that it will become legal later on.

Then again Shard can be used "to reduce card cost you play", so if it's supposed to be legally used in the described scenario, it seem that playing the card and checking if I can afford it is performed in the same window.

I guess is about timing

When you check if you can play a card?
When you decide the reduction cost?

If reduction cost goes before checking if you can play a card then you can play it as, when you check if you can play it, the cost, it is zero.

In case this is ruled (reductions goes before checking the card requisites) the procurer can use the shard to recruit another procurer.
